_translator_notes: Tagalog (tl) — TRANSLATOR NOTES: Most values below are English placeholders. A professional translator should replace them with Tagalog. EXCEPTION: Keys marked with [TRANSLATED] are fully translated and must NOT be reverted to English. These cover safety-critical scenarios where a Filipino farmer may not read English: scan.counterfeit.*, ocr.safety_gate.toxicity_i_warning, ocr.safety_gate.toxicity_ii_warning. When adding new safety-critical keys to en.json, translate them here immediately — never leave a safety-critical key as an English placeholder.
